acceptanceCriteria: Notice lines carry a monotonic sequence and a repeated line is detectably duplicate (test)
An optional ack file or command records that a session read notice N; status shows unacknowledged notices (test)
ATR amended; focused dispatch tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1834 (PR #1153). The host-neutral notice file can repeat a line after a crash between append and marker, and nothing proves a non-Claude session polled it. Recorded as an ATR failure mode and non-goal. Evidence: TestATRV0125_NoticeFileValidationAndRetry. Expected: notices carry a sequence so sessions dedupe, and an optional acknowledgement path lets dispatch record that a notice was read.
title: dispatch notice-file delivery is at-least-once and has no read confirmation
